title: SSW Food
subtitle: Food and beverage manufacturing Japanese for Specified Skilled Worker (飲食料品製造業)

units.title: Food hygiene basics
units.intro: Food poisoning is prevented with three rules: do not bring germs in, do not let them grow, and kill them.

terms.note: The first of the three rules.

terms.en: to kill (germs), for example by heating

questions.q: Which action matches 増やさない (do not let germs multiply)?
options: Keep chilled food in the refrigerator quickly
Heat food until the center is hot
questions.why: Low temperatures slow the growth of bacteria.

questions.q: Which action matches 付けない (do not let germs get on food)?
options: Wash hands and use separate cutting boards
questions.why: Clean hands and separate tools stop germs reaching the food.

questions.q: A worker finds a piece of plastic in a product. What is this called?
questions.why: Any object that should not be in food is 異物.

questions.q: Which is one main cause of 食中毒?
questions.why: Bacteria, viruses, parasites and some chemicals cause food poisoning.

units.title: HACCP
units.intro: HACCP finds the steps where hazards can happen and controls them at critical points, with monitoring and records. In Japan, food businesses are required to manage hygiene in line with HACCP.

terms.reading: じゅうようかんりてん

questions.q: In HACCP, what is a 重要管理点 (CCP)?
options: A step where control is essential to prevent or remove a hazard
Any step where workers take a break
The place where products are sold
questions.why: A CCP is a step where a hazard must be controlled.

questions.q: The rule says the center temperature must reach 75 °C for 1 minute. What is this?
questions.why: A critical limit is the value that separates safe from unsafe.

questions.q: The thermometer shows the oil was too cold, so the batch is reheated and the cause fixed. What is this?
questions.why: When monitoring shows a problem, corrective action deals with the product and the cause.

questions.q: Why keep 記録 in HACCP?
options: To prove that controls were done and to find problems
questions.why: Records show the plan is working and help trace problems.

units.title: Personal hygiene
units.intro: People are the biggest source of contamination. Check your health, dress correctly, and wash your hands the right way.

terms.en: lint roller (to remove hair and dust)

questions.q: You have diarrhea in the morning. What should you do?
options: Tell your supervisor before starting work
Work as usual and say nothing
Work faster to go home early
questions.why: Illness like diarrhea can spread food poisoning; report it first.

questions.q: Why use a 粘着ローラー on work clothes before entering?
options: To remove hair and dust that could fall into food
questions.why: Hair and dust are common foreign matter.

questions.q: When must you wash your hands?
options: After using the toilet and before touching food
Only at the end of the day
questions.why: Hands carry germs from the toilet, raw food and rubbish.

questions.q: Which is correct about the 帽子 (hair cover)?
options: All hair must be inside it
It can be worn loosely on the back of the head
Short hair does not need it
questions.why: Hair must be fully covered to prevent it falling into food.

units.title: Cleaning and 5S
units.intro: 5S keeps the workplace safe and clean: sort, set in order, shine, standardize, sustain. Clean first, then sanitize.

terms.en: set in order (a place for everything)
sustain (keeping the rules as a habit)

questions.q: Throwing away tools that are no longer used is which S?
questions.why: 整理 means removing what is not needed.

questions.q: Putting every knife back in its labeled place is which S?
questions.why: 整頓 gives everything a fixed place.

questions.q: In what order do you treat a cutting board?
options: Wash off dirt (洗浄) first, then sanitize (消毒)
questions.why: Dirt protects germs, so clean first, then disinfect.

questions.q: Which S means following the rules every day until it is a habit?
questions.why: しつけ keeps the other four S going.

units.title: Allergens and labels
units.intro: A small amount of an allergen can be dangerous. Keep allergens separate and make sure labels are correct.

terms.reading: とくていげんざいりょう

questions.q: Which date is used for foods that spoil quickly, such as sandwiches?
questions.why: 消費期限 is the date until which the food is safe to eat.

questions.q: A line made a product with milk and next will make a milk-free product. What prevents 交差汚染?
options: Clean the line and tools thoroughly before the change
questions.why: Allergen residue on equipment can reach the next product.

questions.q: Which of these is one of Japan's 特定原材料?
questions.why: Egg, milk, wheat, shrimp, crab, peanut, buckwheat and walnut are among the required items.

questions.q: Why is a wrong 表示 (label) dangerous?
options: An allergic customer may eat something unsafe
questions.why: People rely on labels to avoid allergens.

units.title: Temperature control
units.intro: Bacteria grow fast in the danger zone between about 10 °C and 60 °C. Heat well, cool quickly, and check the temperature.

terms.reading: きゅうそくれいきゃく

questions.q: Where do you measure 中心温度?
options: At the thickest center part of the food
In the air of the room
questions.why: The center heats last, so it shows whether the whole food is cooked.

questions.q: Cooked soup will be stored. What is the safest way to cool it?
options: 急速冷却: cool it quickly, for example in shallow containers
Leave the big pot on the table overnight
Cover it with a towel to keep it warm
questions.why: Moving quickly through the danger zone limits bacterial growth.

questions.q: What is the safest way to thaw frozen meat?
options: Leave it on the counter all day
Put it in warm water for hours
Thaw and refreeze it many times
questions.why: Thawing in the refrigerator keeps the food out of the danger zone.

questions.q: Why check the refrigerator with a 温度計 and record it?
options: To make sure food stays cold enough
questions.why: Monitoring and records show the temperature control works.

units.title: Workplace safety
units.intro: Factories have knives, machines, wet floors and heavy loads. Follow the rules, report danger, and stop machines before touching them.

terms.reading: ひじょうていしボタン

terms.en: point-and-call (pointing and saying a check aloud)

terms.reading: ほうこく・れんらく・そうだん

questions.q: Food gets stuck inside a running machine. What do you do first?
options: Stop the machine (and lock it out) before reaching in
Reach in quickly while it runs
Hit the machine to free it
questions.why: Never put hands into a moving machine.

questions.q: What is 指差し呼称?
options: Pointing at a thing and saying the check out loud
Calling a friend on the phone
questions.why: Pointing and calling reduces mistakes by focusing attention.

questions.q: The floor is wet and someone might 滑る. What should you do?
options: Clean it up or report it right away
Walk around it and say nothing
questions.why: Wet floors cause many falls; act and report quickly.

questions.q: You are not sure how to use a new machine. What fits 報・連・相?
options: Ask (consult) your supervisor before using it
Try it alone to learn faster
questions.why: Consulting before acting prevents accidents.

units.title: Production and quality
units.intro: Good products come from following the procedure, checking quality, and being able to trace every lot.

questions.q: Why record the ロット number of ingredients?
options: So products can be traced and recalled if there is a problem
To make the box look nice
It is only for the tax office
questions.why: Lot records make traceability possible.

questions.q: During 検品 you find a dented, leaking package. What is it?
options: 不良品 (a defective product): separate it and report
questions.why: Defects must be removed from the line and reported.

questions.q: What does a 金属探知機 check for?
questions.why: Metal detectors find metal foreign matter.

questions.q: Which helps 品質管理 the most?
options: Following the standard procedure every time
Changing the recipe when you feel like it
questions.why: Standard procedures make quality consistent.
